name: Akashi Kaikyō Bridge
hint: The strait is open water from bank to bank. Hang everything from a long main cable - and stiffen the deck with a truss so heavy trucks cannot make it ripple.

history.name: Akashi Kaikyō Bridge
history.span: Main span 1,991 m · side spans 960 m
facts: It was planned after the 1955 Shiun Maru disaster, when two ferries sank in a storm and 168 people died.
The 1995 Great Hanshin earthquake moved the towers apart while it was being built, lengthening the main span by about 1 m.
Its cables contain about 300,000 km of wire - enough to go around the Earth more than seven times.
history.why: The longest suspension span in the world from 1998 to 2022, built to survive typhoons, strong tides and earthquakes.
